author: OpenAI
description:
Over six months, the SME AI Accelerator brought practical AI training to small and medium-sized businesses across Europe. Delivered by OpenAI Academy with Booking.com, the program combined online learning with events in Dublin, Warsaw, London, Munich, Milan, and Paris. Through mentor-led demonstrations, participants explored how ChatGPT and Codex can save time, strengthen operations, and create more room for growth.

SMEs represent 99% of European businesses. Expanding their access to practical AI skills will be critical to Europe’s innovation, competitiveness, and prosperity.
title: How European Small Businesses Are Using ChatGPT and Codex | OpenAI Academy

author: OpenAI
description:
OpenAI Academy and California GO-Biz brought hands-on AI training to San Diego’s small business community. At SDSU’s Tula Community Center, participants explored ChatGPT fundamentals and advanced workflows for marketing, customer communications, administrative tasks, and other everyday business needs.

San Diego was the second stop in a statewide OpenAI Academy series designed to expand access to practical AI skills.
title: How California Small Businesses Are Using ChatGPT | OpenAI Academy
